sloka: तदा अहम् दंडकारण्ये विचरन् धर्म दूषकः ।आसादयम् तदा रामम् तापसम् धर्मम् आश्रितम् ॥३-३९-७॥
transliteration: tadā aham daṁḍakāraṇye vicaran dharma dūṣakaḥ ।āsādayam tadā rāmam tāpasam dharmam āśritam ॥3-39-7॥

translations.english: I encountered again the righteous Rama who was in the form of an ascetic, with venerable Sita and the great warrior Lakshmana.
